name: order-lookup
title: Order lookup
description: Where is my order? An order number and email form for guests, with answers that never reveal who has orders.
docs: onLookup resolves with whatever should appear under the form, or with null when nothing matches: a missing order and a wrong email give the same words. Reject for a failure on your side. The answer under the form goes away as soon as a field is edited. Rate-limit the endpoint behind it; the form cannot do that for you.
